learningObjectives: Create and access one-dimensional and multidimensional arrays.
Manipulate strings using common Java String methods.

activities.title: Array Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore indexes, elements, and array length.

content.concept: An array stores multiple values of the same type using indexed positions beginning at zero.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Index Explorer
activities.instruction: Move through the array to inspect each index.

content.concept: An array element is accessed by its index, while the length property gives the number of elements.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: String Method Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each task with the correct String method.

content.concept: String methods such as length, substring, contains, equals, and toUpperCase support common text operations.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Array Processing Builder
activities.instruction: Build a loop that processes every array element.

content.concept: Loops can systematically access array elements to calculate, search, filter, or transform data.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
